name: open-seo
description: Open source alternative to Semrush and Ahrefs
one_liner: A do-it-yourself SEO toolkit for keyword research, rank tracking, and competitor analysis that you pay for by usage instead of an expensive monthly subscription.
buyer: A solo SEO consultant or small marketing agency currently priced out of Semrush or Ahrefs subscriptions.
business_use_cases: A freelance SEO consultant self-hosts it to serve small-business clients without eating Semrush's monthly fee.
A content marketing agency white-labels the hosted version to offer SEO audits to its own clients.
An indie SaaS founder self-hosts it to track rankings for their own product's keywords.

money_ideas.idea: White-label the hosted version and resell it to agency clients at a markup.
Offer a one-off '$99 SEO audit for local businesses' report generated from the tool.

steal_this: White-label the hosted version this weekend and sell '$99 SEO audits for local businesses' as a simple one-off report product.
